firstExecutableCensus.finding: All first-pass uncovered rows were RELEASE-profile responsibilities; no market-data/provider/runtime responsibility lacked a qualifying adverse owner.

gapResolutions.RELEASE-FAST: Canonical release rehearsal and Stable evidence gates fail closed on missing/stale Fast binding, identity drift and release invariant loss.
gapResolutions.RELEASE-QUALIFIED: Canonical release rehearsal and Stable evidence gates fail closed on missing/stale Qualified binding and release invariant loss.
gapResolutions.RELEASE-NO-REBUILD: Canonical release rehearsal rejects publish-job rebuild patterns, clobber behavior and mismatched immutable Stable tags.
gapResolutions.RELEASE-MACOS-APPLE-SILICON: Stable evidence gate rejects missing/mismatched native macOS artifact IDs/digests; browser/native routing gate requires independent macOS native qualification ownership.
gapResolutions.RELEASE-WINDOWS-X64: Stable evidence gate rejects missing/mismatched Windows native artifact IDs/digests; browser/native routing gate requires independent Windows native qualification ownership.
gapResolutions.RELEASE-IDENTITY-PROVENANCE: Release-state coherence self-test injects stale handoff, source-fingerprint, cache-identity and immutable-tag conflicts and requires all to be detected.
gapResolutions.RELEASE-RENDERER-CHROME-WEBKIT: Browser risk-routing gate fails closed when Chrome/WebKit/native lane routing or required WebKit/browser-owner contracts disappear.
gapResolutions.RELEASE-TEST-PROFILE-MIGRATION: Exact scan-discovered Go owner proves isolated migration, Stable source immutability, transient-file exclusion and repeat-launch reuse.
gapResolutions.RELEASE-DEVELOPER-SCHEMA-PROBE: Exact scan-discovered Go owner proves explicit opt-in, invalid-argument rejection, redaction, failure/unavailable fail-closed behavior and no provider lifecycle mutation.

RELEASE-FAST.rationale: Current CI/release owners require exact Fast status/run binding and fail on missing/stale/divergent release evidence.

RELEASE-QUALIFIED.rationale: Current CI/release owners require identical-head Qualified status/run binding and fail on missing/stale/divergent release evidence.

RELEASE-NO-REBUILD.rationale: Publication owner explicitly rejects rebuild/clobber/tag divergence and Stable evidence owner rejects provenance drift.

RELEASE-MACOS-APPLE-SILICON.rationale: Missing/mismatched macOS native artifact ID/digest fails Stable evidence and loss of native qualification ownership fails browser/native routing policy.

RELEASE-WINDOWS-X64.rationale: Missing/mismatched Windows native artifact ID/digest fails Stable evidence and loss of native qualification ownership fails browser/native routing policy.

RELEASE-IDENTITY-PROVENANCE.rationale: Executable coherence fixtures require detection of stale handoff, fingerprint/cache identity drift, missing G12 evidence and immutable-tag conflicts.

RELEASE-RENDERER-CHROME-WEBKIT.rationale: Executable browser policy rejects missing Chrome/WebKit/native routing ownership and prevents Fast from silently substituting browser evidence.

RELEASE-TEST-PROFILE-MIGRATION.rationale: Behavior is Go-owned despite conservative RELEASE profile assignment; exact negative owner protects Stable source immutability, transient-file exclusion and repeat migration semantics.

RELEASE-DEVELOPER-SCHEMA-PROBE.rationale: Behavior is Go-owned despite conservative RELEASE profile assignment; exact negative owner rejects invalid/unavailable probe paths, prevents lifecycle mutation and protects redaction/explicit opt-in.

completionCondition: All 180 effective shipped-v18 responsibilities resolve their T4 expectation and have at least one current executable adverse/edge/failure owner whose assertions prove truthful degraded/failure behavior; all declared gaps are closed; exact-head Fast and identical-head Qualified pass.
